about: A chip of BN5's whose code moved into BN6's engine (issue #82's C3): BN5's CanladEX held paralysed (hold: each game's own status step, the same bits in both) at (5,2), MegaMan at (2,2) with a folder of Voltz1 K in both games, BN5's chip 78 by BN5's own code and the registry's 444 by the same code moved (BN5's misc family 0x1A as BN6's 0x6A), the first Custom screen's chip picked and OK, used at t30: every difference of BN6's play from BN5's fails it (docs/multirom/chips-code.md).
